detail.longDescription: I when I edit a LaTeX document which has the commit ID in it, I would like run latexmk -g when I commit to git so the document is updated with its current commit ID, I have not found any way to do this yet. Is it possible? I would prefer not having to install a git post-commit hook every time I make a new document. I edit my LaTeX documents with the LaTeXWorkshop extension on Linux.
